claims.text: SEC EDGAR submissions API query for Coinbase Global, Inc. (CIK 0001679788), forms 10-K/10-Q/8-K, since 2026-08-20, returned exactly 1 filing as of 2026-09-05: an 8-K filed 2026-09-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1679788/000167978826000101/coin-20260901.htm). Direct review of that filing confirms it is triggered solely under Item 5.02 (board of directors change) — expansion of the board from 9 to 10 members and appointment of Anthony Armstrong as director and member of the Audit and Compliance Committee, with standard indemnification agreement and non-employee director compensation program. The filing contains no mention of Circle, USDC, or any distribution/collaboration agreement, and discloses no revenue, guidance, or capital-allocation figures.
claims.note: Circle 분배계약 관련 8-K 부재 지속을 재확인(usdc_economics 축 근거로만 사용 — 이사 선임 자체는 P3 상 노이즈 판정, 별도 축 매핑 없음).

claims.text: Per a cryptoslate.com report (published 2026-09-02, attributed to a 'Coinbase derivatives dashboard snapshot retrieved at 15:42 UTC on Sept. 1'), ahead of the planned 2026-09-09 full migration of Coinbase International Exchange (INTX) derivatives trading onto the Deribit-powered 'Starbase' matching engine, open interest was already concentrated as: Deribit $39.26B (96.6%), Coinbase Derivatives $1.17B (2.9%), International Exchange $226.98M (0.6%).
claims.note: cryptoslate.com은 sources.yaml 미등재 도메인(default_grade=4). 기사는 수치 출처를 'Coinbase 자체 대시보드'로 명시하나 대시보드 원본 URL을 직접 제공하지 않아 1차 URL 역추적 실패 — confirmed=false 유지(D15). 매출·거래량 기여치(달러 기준 실제 거래대금·수수료)는 여전히 미공시.

claims.text: Multiple grade-3/4 outlets (crypto.news 2026-09-02, cryptotimes.io, tradersunion.com) confirm the Deribit 'Starbase' matching-engine migration for Coinbase International Exchange derivatives remains scheduled for 2026-09-09, with an expected ~30-minute downtime window, automatic carryover of open positions/balances, and cancellation of open perpetual-futures orders requiring re-entry post-migration. Deribit's RWA perpetual contracts (USDC-settled, up to 50x leverage, on NVDA/MSFT/META/TSLA/AAPL/GOOGL/AMZN and other names) that were slated to begin 2026-08-31 per the prior run's c_20260820_COIN_006 remain reported as launched/launching on that schedule; no outlet in this window reports a delay, cancellation, or contrary schedule, but none discloses actual post-launch trading volume, open interest, or revenue attributable to the new RWA products specifically.
claims.note: crypto.news·cryptotimes.io·tradersunion.com 모두 sources.yaml 미등재(default grade4). 1차 소스(support.deribit.com, coinbase.com migration 공지 help.coinbase.com/en/international-exchange/deribit)는 안내 페이지일 뿐 실적 수치 미포함 — confirmed=false 유지. c_20260820_COIN_006의 일정 연속성 확인 성격이며 신규 매출 기여 정보는 아님.
